notes: FastGettext._(msgid) or n_(msgid, plural, n) on a :mo text domain, with the domain and locale selected in the call; String#% fills the placeholders.
details: The gem reads .mo files from <path>/<locale>/LC_MESSAGES/<domain>.mo, so prepare writes the bytes to a temporary folder first. For an untranslated plural it applies the locale's rule to the English strings (21 gives the singular in ru), where GNU gettext uses n == 1; the fixtures leave that out for ru.
